raw_site_text: five districts in Tanzania: Moshi, Kwimba, Lushoto, Makete, and Nzega
justification: The study took place in five named districts: Moshi, Kwimba, Lushoto, Makete, and Nzega.
note: Rolled up: Moshi->Kilimanjaro, Kwimba->Mwanza, Lushoto->Tanga, Nzega->Tabora, Makete->Njombe (Makete was in Iringa region at the time of the study; Njombe region was created in 2012, so Iringa is an alternative).
